name: Artemtek Image to Text
description: Converts images (screenshots, photos, etc.) to text using OCR. Processes all images in the input directory.

inputs.name: Input Directory
inputs.description: Directory containing images to convert (PNG, JPG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP).

outputs.name: Output Directory
outputs.description: Directory where text files will be saved (one .txt file per image).
